name: SimpleArduinoTimer
description: A Simple non-blocking Timer for Arduino. Supports millis() or an optional RTC back-end. Supported RTCs: DS3231, DS1307, PCF8523, PCF8563, MCP7940N (via RTClib) and DS1302 (via Makuna RTC library). Select the chip with a compile-time macro.
Notes: RTC support is optional. Define useRTCModule and a chip macro (e.g. RTC_CHIP_DS3231) before including SimpleArduinoTimer.h. RTClib chips require the Adafruit RTClib library; DS1302 requires the Makuna RTC library. Thread safety is also optional: define TIMER_THREAD_SAFE (requires SimpleMutex) to guard every public method with a recursive mutex, TIMER_LOCK_BACKEND_RWLOCK (requires SimpleRWLock) to use shared read locks for read-only methods instead, or TIMER_ENABLE_THREADING (additionally requires SimpleThreadManager) to enable the background monitor thread.
